title: Balint vs. Bondi SHOWDOWN on Epstein Files Tied to Trump Senior Officials Including Lutnick & Others
text: Balint vs. Bondi SHOWDOWN on Epstein Files Tied to Trump Senior Officials Including Lutnick & OthersRep. Becca Balint confronted Attorney General Pam Bondi in a tense House hearing over alleged links between Jeffrey Epstein and senior Trump officials, including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Balint pressed whether the Justice Department had questioned Lutnick about his past contacts with Epstein. Bondi replied that Lutnick had already addressed the issue publicly, prompting Balint to insist the department must answer directly. The exchange highlighted Democratic demands for a full investigation into Epstein-related connections inside the administration. Balint asked repeatedly for a clear “yes or no” on whether three senior officials were tied to Epstein, accusing the Justice Department of dodging accountability while Bondi maintained the process must remain fact-based and impartial. #BeccaBalint #PamBondi #EpsteinFiles #Trump #HowardLutnick #Trump #JusticeDepartment #Congress #Oversight #Accountability #USPolitics #HouseHearing #Transparency #BreakingNews #Democrats #Ethics #Investigations #JeffreyEpstein #Cabinet #Scandal #Politics #oneindianews #oneindiaenglish #breakingnews #worldnews #englishnewslive #englishnews #latestnews #news
